messages:
maya: Hi! I'm Maya, starting on infra team today. I never got an Okta invite email, and Google account isn't provisioned. Also need to set up 1Password and SSH access for repos. Who should I ping?

it-ops-bot: Automations: Okta invite for maya@redwood.dev not found. Please confirm email address and region. If correct, file/helpdesk ticket at #it-ops or DM @sam.

sam: @maya welcome! Sorry about that. I'm on it — can you confirm the email you signed up with? and if you have a personal email for fallback? Also which device (mac/linux)?

maya: maya@redwood.dev — macbook air M2. No invite in spam. Google sign-in gives 'account not provisioned'. 1Password link in onboarding guide is a 403.

sam: Thanks. Resent Okta activation. You should get an email from okta@redwood.com — check spam/Promotions. Also I kicked off Google provisioning; that can take up to 5 minutes after activation. Let me know once you get Okta link.

it-ops-bot: System: Okta activation email resent to maya@redwood.dev (action id 98765). Google Workspace sync job queued.

maya: Got the Okta email and completed activation, but now when I open SSO in Chrome I get an endless redirect loop. Works in Firefox. Any known Mac Safari/Chrome issue?

jordan: Hey @maya — for Chrome SSO loops on Mac try: Preferences > Privacy > Clear site data for redwood.okta.com and disable 3rd-party cookie blocking for the session. Also if you have 1Password extension enabled with autofill, sometimes it interferes — try disabling it temporarily.

maya: That fixed Chrome, thanks! 1Password CLI still 403 on the onboarding link though.

elaine: 1Password: we require the team account. Sam, I linked maya to infra vault. Try sign-in with CLI:

```bash
eval $(op signin redwood)
op account get --account redwood
```

If that errors paste the output here (redact tokens).

maya: CLI worked after sign-in, can see infra vault. SSH key question: do we add public key to GitHub or to internal repo manager?

devex: For now add SSH key to GitHub Enterprise under your account and ping #eng-setup to request org repo access. If you prefer, share the public key here and we can add, but we usually ask you to add it yourself.

maya: Added key to GH, requested org access. Thanks team! :party_parrot: 

sam: Welcome aboard! If anything else, DM me or @devex.
